title: The World's Most Valuable Companies
subtitle: Market capitalization of top companies, year-end, 2000–2025

events.title: Microsoft Rules the World
events.text: Microsoft opens 2000 as the planet's most valuable company at roughly $586 billion.

events.title: Dot-Com Bubble Bursts
events.text: Cisco's brief run near the top evaporates as the Nasdaq loses over 50% of its value.

events.title: Google Goes Public
events.text: Google IPOs at $85/share via a Dutch auction, valuing it around $27 billion.

events.title: First $1 Trillion Company
events.text: PetroChina's Shanghai debut briefly makes it worth over $1 trillion, a world first.

events.title: Financial Crisis Wipes Out GE
events.text: General Electric's market cap crashes from $369B to just $102B within a year.

events.title: Tesla Goes Public
events.text: Tesla IPOs at a modest $1.7 billion valuation, tiny compared to today's giants.

events.title: Facebook's Rocky IPO
events.text: Facebook debuts at $104 billion but stock halves within months of going public.

events.title: Alibaba's Record IPO
events.text: Alibaba raises $25 billion in New York, then the largest IPO in history.

events.title: Apple Hits $1 Trillion
events.text: Apple becomes the first US company ever to close above a $1 trillion valuation.

events.title: Saudi Aramco's Mega-IPO
events.text: Aramco lists in Riyadh valued at $1.7 trillion, the world's biggest ever IPO.

events.title: Tesla's Wild Ride
events.text: Tesla stock rockets over 700% in 2020, joining the S&P 500 in December.

events.title: Nvidia Joins the Big Leagues
events.text: Nvidia's market cap tops $700 billion as GPU and AI demand surges.

events.title: Meta's Worst Year Ever
events.text: Meta shares fall 64% in 2022, erasing over $600 billion in value.

events.title: AI Boom Ignites Nvidia
events.text: Nvidia's valuation nearly quadruples in 2023 on explosive ChatGPT-era chip demand.

events.title: Berkshire Joins Trillion Club
events.text: Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway crosses $1 trillion in market cap, August 2024.

events.title: Nvidia Hits $4 Trillion
events.text: Nvidia becomes the first company ever to reach a $4 trillion valuation, July 2025.

notes: Year-end (approx. December) market capitalization in USD, reconstructed from historical snapshots, IPO records and news reports; many values (especially pre-2010 and non-US firms) are interpolated/estimated between known anchor points and should be read as directional, not exact. Null = not yet public or not yet founded (Alphabet IPO 2004, Tesla IPO 2010, Meta/Facebook IPO 2012, Alibaba IPO 2014, Saudi Aramco IPO Dec 2019). General Electric 2023-2025 values represent its successor GE Aerospace after the 2022-2024 conglomerate breakup. Figures for 2025 partly estimated from early-2026 data trends (e.g. Nvidia, Apple, Microsoft) since full year-end closing data was still emerging at research time. No single "world total" market cap exists for this topic since it compares individual company valuations.

music.prompt: Instrumental corporate house track capturing decades of market booms and busts: driving four-on-the-floor kick, punchy sidechained bass, shimmering arpeggiated synths, and triumphant brass stabs building from a moody minor intro into an anthemic, energetic peak. Tempo 122 BPM, cinematic build-ups and drops representing dot-com crash, financial crisis dip, and AI-boom climax. No vocals.
